name: Alexander McKim
bio: a Representative from Maryland; born in Brandywine, Del., January 10, 1748; pursued an academic course; moved to Baltimore, Md.; member of the Maryland house of delegates, 1778; served in the Revolutionary War, member of the Baltimore Independent Cadets and of the First Baltimore Cavalry; fought under General Lafayette in the Virginia campaign of 1781; member of the Maryland state senate, 1806-1810; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Eleventh and to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1809-March 3, 1815); engaged in mercantile pursuits; justice of court of quarter sessions; presiding judge of the Baltimore County Orphans' Court until his death; died on January 18, 1832, in Baltimore, Md.; interment in Greenmount Cemetery, Baltimore, Md.
